title: Erratic g4 xdrip readings
body:
Hi all,
My son has been using the g4 with xdrip for the last 7 months, generally the readings and performance has been very reliable. We have xbridge 'box' and xdrip plus installed on his Samsung J5 phone.
Readings from the last 3 sensors have been very erratic, jumping from ⬇️⬇️ to ⬆️⬆️ constantly throughout the day. We had to replace the last sensor after three days and now the new one is doing the same again.
He does wear the sensor on his arm, which we are aware is not licensed but he has always used his arm as he is very slight with very little body fat anywhere else.
Does anyone else experience these issues? Is the transmitter failing? Are there any logs available via xdrip to help troubleshoot? Thanks 
![IMG-20190612-WA0000](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/44970282/59389978-cce1aa80-8d67-11e9-9630-dbe7a7163530.jpg)

comments.body:
Probably you have already looked into these suggestions, but worth putting
them forward.
1) Does this improve if he drinks some fluid?  Dehydration can cause this
sort of thing (experience it myself all the time).
2) Do you make sure the G4 contacts are cleaned with an alcohol swab with
every change?  Poor connection to the sensor can often cause this, and I
see it occur on myself after 10-15 days.
If the above two have been checked out, then report the sensor as failed to
your supplier.  DON'T mention xDrip or xBridge as they will void the
warranty on the sensors.
I have had a number of batches of sensors over the last 5 years that have
gone noisy way too early compared to others.  The supplier here has usually
been good at replacing bad batches.
The worst was a batch that the sensor mount came away from the adhesive
after two days.  Two out of four sensors in the box did this.  Both were
replaced at no charge.
Cheers
